tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Email address verification for AI agents and lead-qualification pipelines: syntax check, disposable-domain detection, role-account (info@, support@) detection, free-provider flag, domain typo suggestion (gmial.com -> gmail.com) and DNS MX/A validation via DNS-over-HTTPS. Returns verdict valid, risky

tools.name: email_auth
tools.description: Email deliverability and spoofing-protection audit for a domain: parses SPF (mechanisms, top-level DNS lookup count, +all/~all/-all), DMARC (policy, pct, rua/ruf, alignment), probes common DKIM selectors, and reports MX, BIMI, MTA-STS and TLS-RPT. Returns prioritised findings with fix hints and a 0-

tools.name: domain_dns
tools.description: DNS lookup for a domain through DNS-over-HTTPS: A, AAAA, NS, MX, TXT, CAA, SOA, CNAME records with TTLs, plus DNSSEC presence (DNSKEY, DS) and the resolver validation flag. Structured JSON for domain research, due diligence and infrastructure agents.

tools.name: site_contacts
tools.description: Public contact details published on a website: emails (including mailto links and [at] obfuscation, classified role or personal), phone numbers normalised to E.164, social profile links, address hints and Swedish organisation numbers for .se sites. tools.name: site_audit
tools.description: Technical SEO audit of one page: HTTP status, redirect chain, title and meta description length, H1 count, canonical, robots meta, hreflang, Open Graph and Twitter tags, JSON-LD types, images without alt text, link counts, security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options), technology detection (CMS, fra

tools.name: url_markdown
tools.description: Fetches a web page (up to 1.5 MB, 8 s timeout) and returns clean Markdown: title, headings, paragraphs, lists, links, images, code blocks and simple tables, with navigation and footers removed. Ready to feed to LLMs. Static HTML only, no JavaScript rendering. Honours robots.txt.

tools.name: se_validate
tools.description: Validates Swedish identifiers with checksum and date logic: personnummer, samordningsnummer, organisationsnummer (including sole-trader and VAT forms), bankgiro, plusgiro and OCR payment references. Returns normalised forms and error codes. No application-level storage.

tools.name: iban_check
tools.description: IBAN validation: country-specific length (from a bundled table of IBAN countries), mod-97 checksum, normalised and formatted output, BBAN and check digits. Does not check that the account exists.

tools.name: se_account_to_iban
tools.description: Converts a Swedish clearing number and account number to IBAN and BIC, identifies the bank, and validates the account number checksum according to the bank-specific rules. Clearing table dated 2026-10-16; does not check that the account exists.

tools.name: bank_days
tools.description: Adds or subtracts Swedish bank days (weekends, public holidays and midsommarafton, julafton, nyarsafton excluded) to a date. Optional mode=work counts only weekends and red days. Returns the result date with weekday, ISO week and holiday names for both dates.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_check, site_audit · Private data: domain_dns, site_contacts · Public sink: email_check, email_auth.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_check, site_audit · Private data: domain_dns, site_contacts · Public sink: email_check, email_auth

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
